name: RemoveBadPixelsTiltSeries
label: Remove Bad Pixels
description: Replace bad pixels (zingers from stray radiation, hot and dead detector pixels) in every image by the median of their 3 x 3 neighbourhood. A pixel is bad when it differs from that median by more than the threshold, in units of the image's noise level.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.label: Threshold (noise standard deviations)
parameters.description: How far from its neighbourhood median a pixel must be, in robust noise standard deviations, to be replaced. 5 leaves noise alone; lower values also catch weaker outliers but start to touch real fine detail.
